findings.summary: Blocking inference has no state validation after decider.decide() returns
findings.detail: Line 45: d = decider.decide(state, prev) is a blocking HTTP call that can take seconds. There is NO state snapshot/validation pattern to detect if PAUSE/STOP/RESET/backend-switch/preprocessor-switch modified the episode state while the inference was in flight. If control plane operations are added later (for 2P or live model switching), a stale decision can execute on a changed state.
findings.current_code_state: Sequential episode loop; no threading/control plane active yet. Current code is safe for single-threaded use.
findings.impact: Design gap: when control plane is added, stale decisions will execute unless snapshot+validate pattern is implemented. This is NOT a bug in current code, but a missing architectural pattern.
findings.required_fix: Before implementing PAUSE/STOP/RESET/backend-switch: (1) snapshot state/config under lock, (2) release lock, (3) call decider.decide(), (4) reacquire lock, (5) validate RUN_ID/EPISODE_ID/SEAT_ID/DECISION_ID/BACKEND_ID/PREPROCESSOR_ID/PLAY_STATE, (6) execute action only if signature matches.
findings.verification: NOT_TESTED - control plane not yet implemented

P1 findings are pre-existing governance issues (branch collision, machine paths, sponsor cost). P2 findings are documentation (now corrected with HOWTO). SUPPORTED verdicts for all live tested lanes (scripted, Ollama/Liquid local, Vithia, 1P, backend attribution, secret scan). BLOCKED/NOT_TESTED for sponsor integrations (Tenki, Mitosis) and unimplemented control features (2P, races, model-switch). Submission candidate ready with accurate claim distinctions (no false SUPPORTED claims for unexecuted features).
